Summary of the change: I extended `toBusinessDay` in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java` so the registration-date roll now also skips the five fixed public holidays (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28), rolling forward one day at a time until it reaches a day that is neither a weekend nor a holiday — matching the reference algorithm the tests replicate.

- Added a `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` set and a helper `isNonBusinessDay`.
- Replaced the previous weekend-only, single-jump logic with an iterative roll (needed because a holiday can fall adjacent to a weekend or another holiday, e.g. 2026-12-25→…→2026-12-28).
- Added the `java.util.Set` import.
